exact_statement:
The search generated 808 ranked candidate rows across exact family expressions,
family components and n-grams, source-native construction length/grouping,
boundary profiles, edition-specific primary STA members, and postselected
depth-two AND/OR combinations. Controls include 2,520 exact within-array
CONTACT-count permutations, cyclic rotations, leave-one-folio diagnostics,
three-reading mask comparisons, uncertainty assignments, and a low-capacity
length/group matched sensitivity. The reported conditional-library maximum
holds fixed the joint library selected on the observed data; it does not rerun
that selection under every permutation and is not a full max-search correction.
None of these ranks is a confirmatory probability. The f80 formal subanalysis
has coverage for 8/10 positions, and the BFE scan for 29/30 nonholdout rows.

exact_statement:
No candidate earns confirmation-grade status, but the search is not empty.
The most useful risky leads are a member-level `A1` depletion, a weak `K/KA`
component tendency, and the sharply page-local `AQA` row/register contrast.
Their weaknesses are now explicit: uncertainty dependence, length confounding,
array direction reversal, one-page concentration, postselection, and negative
selector-paid MDL. These are exactly the kinds of dirty hypotheses the YOLO
branch is meant to surface.

The relaxed YOLO pass produced a real exploratory signal, but not a stable
physical segmentation result. Two source-aware AI localizers marked all 34
registered cuts. They agreed within the frozen 50-pixel tolerance on 23 cuts;
both variants were retained for the other 11, yielding 45 opaque crops. Two
fresh `fork_turns=none` reviewers then scored every crop without locus,
transcription, target/control identity, or hypothesis access.

exact_statement:
Other plain-alphabet `COL` records include tentative letters under blue paint
on f9v and single or uncertain letters on f1v, f2v, f20r, f29r, f32r, and
f99v. They strengthen the existence of a production-annotation layer but add
no second Voynich-script observation. The f2r record is the catalogue's only
`COL` candidate written in Voynich script. Alternate human readings ZL3b and
RF1b agree exactly on `ios an on`; IT2a has no row.

claim_ceiling: Historical wording only; extraction is not scientific validation, endorsement, complete semantic parsing, or deduplication.
exact_statement:
Within the frozen retained-node formal layer, the complete composite is not an
indivisible atom. Component `i` occurs in 35 physical loci and 14 complete root forms; 15 loci contain 13 different
`i+...` composites. This evidence is reading-sensitive—only four of those
composite loci have two-reading support and none have all three—so it is a
productive but unstable small family. Component `os` is much stronger: it
occurs in 406 physical loci and 104 complete forms, while 70 different
`...+os` composites span 293 loci, 205 supported by all three readings. Thus
`i+os` is a unique combination of reusable components, not evidence for an
atomic colour word. A package-level coverage correction found 3,838 literal
surface groups omitted from that formal layer, but f2r.15 has no residual and
none of the omitted groups contains literal `i` or `o`. Thus the frozen formal
counts are unchanged and there is no literal `i`/`o`-bearing residual
candidate. This does not constrain what a future parser might assign to an
unparsed group. The counts remain partial formal-layer statistics, not a
translation or exhaustive surface absence.

exact_statement:
This is a function-and-context candidate, not a translation. The source does
not establish that the phrase means GREEN, which unit would carry a colour
value, whether it names a pigment or an action, or whether the painter obeyed
the note. It also does not establish that the plain-alphabet notes were written
by the main-text scribe or that the main text is German. A copied exemplar
annotation and a non-colour label remain viable.

Do not mine shared substrings from f4r/f7r prose or assign `ios`, `an`, `on`,
`i`, `os`, `a`, or `o` a colour gloss.

exact_statement:
The strongest genuinely grammar-licensed local handoff is all-reading-stable
`QOLCHEDY | QOKAIN` on f81v and f82r: the first exact tuple is a one-group
DY-closed field and the second exact tuple opens the following field. The
all-reading-stable surface sequence `DY | DAIIN` crosses Herbal-A/hand 1 and
Biological-B/hand 2, but GDT327 parses it as consecutive `D:Y` and `D:AIIN`
cards, not as a closure followed by a value. Its old checkpoint reading is
withdrawn. The strongest phrase-level construction is now exact latent
`Y–AIIN–Y`: it alone among all contiguous 3/4-card paths recurs across two fixed
pages, rendered as `CHY TAIIN SHY` on f10r and `CHEY DAIIN CHEY` on f83r.
The strongest content-system guesses remain local. More importantly,
Herbal `CHOL` and Biological `OL` can be the same exact O-framed L card under
different observed wrappers; they may not receive different meanings.
That shared card remains a broad relation/classification candidate, and
`D/S + AR + OL + right state` differentiates related hydraulic constructions. `OTAIN OLKAL`
is a tub/apparatus caption candidate; `OKAL` is an anonymous card reused between
a figure label and two prose blocks; SOL is a flexible Biological construction
head. The clearest local field grammar opens with QOKAIIN/QOKEEY/QOKAL-like
cards, admits OL/DAIIN/CHEDY-like interiors, and closes with formally licensed
QOKEEDY/QOKEDY/SHEDY/LCHEDY states. Displayed `CHOL` crosses Herbal-A/hand 1 and circle/hand 4, but the circle
loci are outside GDT327 and cannot be assigned the same parser-level card. On
the covered Herbal/Bio prose, the CHOL card has unwrapped `OL` realizations and
the exact CTHY card likewise crosses registers under different wrappers.
On circle pages the written label is residual data added to visible
ring/star/radial coordinates. f67r2 has three distinct counted layers—not just
12 and 7, but also an independently catalogued central ring of 8 labels.

dichtes CTHDY/OCTHDY/QOCTHDY/CHCTHDY-Schwesterfeld. Beide Zielbelege liegen

Drogenzubereitung, Grundform`, nicht ungeprüft „Krautzubereitung“; Blatt/Kraut
bleibt eine lokale Herbal-Einengung. Damit bleiben O+CTH=Drogenzubereitung,
D=fertig aufbereitet und Y=Grundform im deutschen Ausdruck sichtbar.

belegte Zusammenschreibung als occurrence-spezifische Karte und unterdrückt in
der praktischen Satzfassung die doppelte Nachbarglosse.

exact_statement:
Die drei Leser stimmen dagegen darin überein, dass `tolg` die schwächste Karte
ist. ZL3b und die RF1b-Endung stützen `g` und damit versuchsweise „ein Gran“;
IT2a `tolm` bietet „eine Handvoll“, RF1b verbindet den Bereich zu `chotolg`.
Der Renderer setzt einen konkreten Default, versteckt den Einheitenrivalen aber
nicht und exportiert keine allgemeine g-Regel.

trocknen und anschließend auf Kühlstufe II bringen, hält an vier

sichtbare Portionsvariante. `qockhol = qo + ckhol` bewahrt an sechs Positionen
GDT679s Kompositdrogenstoff und macht daraus den konkreten Zugabebefehl.

Saatgutansatz stehen, aber die gelernte Lesung „leicht erhitzte Salzlösung“ ist
nicht entschieden. `orom=Handvoll` bleibt an das Ganzwort gebunden; es entsteht
kein freies `m=Handvoll`. Das kurze `da` exportiert wegen `dor/das/dey/day` und
der Dreifachabweichung `da/do/e` keinen Buchstabenwert, sondern nur den lokalen
Teilungs-/Messkern.

exact_statement: Die Prozessfolge ist für 1400–1450 nicht exotisch. Die Edition [Medieval Welsh Medical Texts](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK558238/) arbeitet mit vier Handschriften aus dem späten 14. und frühen 15. Jahrhundert. In den dort edierten Rezepten erscheinen gerade die Kombinationen **zerstoßen**, **stehen lassen**, **durch feine frisch gewaschene Leinwand pressen oder seihen** und **aufbewahren**. Die [Beschreibung der überlieferten Sammlungen](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK558256/?report=reader) enthält zudem einen nahezu vollständigen Arbeitsgang: Ansatz im geschlossenen Gefäß ruhen lassen, durch Leinwand seihen, abkühlen, Flüssigkeit ablaufen lassen, klären, erneut abkühlen und im Gefäß bewahren. Die [Handschriftenbeschreibung](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK558267/) datiert einen zentralen Zeugen an das Ende des 14. beziehungsweise den Anfang des 15. Jahrhunderts.

kompiliertes Nachschlagebuch für einen medizinischen Haushalt, eine Infirmarie

Das Bild-vor-Text-Prinzip bleibt eine **lokale Zielseitenhypothese**. Es ist
historisch möglich, aber nicht als allgemeines Gesetz abgesichert. Gerade die
leeren Bildräume im Carrara-Herbal belegen den umgekehrten oder gemischten
Ablauf für manche Lagen. Der Kern von Wellcome MS.8515 steht in einer Hand,
seine Rezepte wurden aber durch spätere Hände ergänzt; British Library Add MS
82946 vereint einen Stundenbuchkern mit Kalendern, astronomischen Tafeln und
späteren Ergänzungen

mehrstufige Kompilation, nicht die Berufe oder Absichten der Zielschreiber.
